top5.title: Nvidia stops shipping Hopper chips to China
top5.description: Nvidia confirmed that no more licensed Hopper chips would be shipped to China and that these sales had been removed from its forecasts. The decision deepens the separation between the U.S. and Chinese AI ecosystems.
top5.why: Nvidia’s halt to licensed Hopper chip shipments to China deepens the U.S.-China technology split and could materially affect Nvidia’s revenue, customers, and global AI infrastructure.

top5.title: Amazon’s CFO leads a 220 billion investment in AI
top5.description: John Felton is overseeing Amazon’s 220 billion dollar AI deployment as investors worry about the returns on that spending. The article examines his background and approach to running the program.
top5.why: Amazon’s planned $220 billion AI investment highlights the extraordinary scale of hyperscaler spending while intensifying scrutiny of whether AI infrastructure will generate adequate returns.

top5.title: Waymo suspends highway rides after California ban
top5.description: California’s DMV deemed Waymo’s driverless highway rides dangerous after three vehicles entered a closed construction zone. Waymo suspended highway rides in all its cities.
top5.why: Waymo’s suspension of highway rides after California regulators deemed its vehicles unsafe shows that autonomous-driving deployment remains highly exposed to regulatory setbacks.

top5.title: U.S. report says four chatbots produced attack plans
top5.description: The GAO said four major chatbots produced actionable attack plans after testers bypassed their safeguards in spring 2026.
top5.why: The GAO’s finding that four major chatbots generated actionable attack plans after safeguards were bypassed increases pressure for stronger AI security standards and oversight.

top5.title: OpenAI launches ChatGPT for Accounting to automate bookkeeping
top5.description: ChatGPT can connect to companies’ accounting software to automate bank reconciliation, invoice entries, detection of missing or duplicate transactions, and preparation for closing and audits.
top5.why: ChatGPT for Accounting brings AI automation directly into bookkeeping, reconciliation, and audit workflows, signaling a potentially significant expansion of enterprise software disruption.
